characters.continuity: StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty / Legacy of the Void
characters.summary: Jim Raynor is a seasoned guerrilla commander, marksman, and freedom fighter who utilizes advanced terran infantry gear, heavy weapons, and strategic command. He excels at leading resistance movements against tyrannical regimes and extraterrestrial threats.
weaknesses: Physically human without extraordinary innate durability outside armor

sources.supports: Combat background, weapons, and armor capabilities.

feats.claim: Led successful guerrilla operations against the Terran Dominion and rescued Sarah Kerrigan during early campaigns.

notableResults.citation: StarCraft II: Heart of the Swarm

campaignTags.claim: Wears heavy terran combat armor in combat.
Utilizes advanced terran firearms and communication gear.

unknowns: Exact limits of his resilience against high-end protoss energy weapons.

characters.summary: Jinx is an erratic and chaotic anarchist who relies on an expansive arsenal of firearms, explosives, and rocket launchers to overwhelm enemies from a distance.

mechanisms: Mines and traps for area denial

weaknesses: Fragile physique in close-quarters melee combat without distance
limitations: Prone to erratic behavior and loss of focus under emotional duress

sources.supports: Weapons arsenal, explosive techniques, and combat style.

feats.claim: Caused widespread city-block level destruction across Piltover using remote explosives and Super Mega Death Rocket.

notableResults.note: Their skirmishes often end in tactical disengagements.

campaignTags.claim: Uses custom-built Hextech and chemtech explosives, traps, and guns.
Deploys advanced customized firearms and rockets.

unknowns: Exact durability limits against direct sustained energy projection.

characters.summary: Joel Miller is a hardened survivor who employs stealth, improvised crafting, firearms, and brutal close-quarters combat to outlast hostile humans and infected.
weaknesses: Normal human vulnerability to gunfire, infection spores, and sharp trauma
limitations: Subject to normal human physical fatigue and mortal injuries

sources.supports: Combat skills, survival tactics, and weapon proficiency.

feats.claim: Cleared out a heavily guarded hospital single-handedly to rescue Ellie.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and killed David in a brutal knife fight.

campaignTags.claim: Crafts and throws Molotov cocktails that create fire zones.
Employs stealth tactics to move undetected through hostile areas.

unknowns: Performance against opponents with superhuman speed or energy powers.

characters.summary: King Dedede is a powerful heavyweight monarch who wields a giant wooden hammer, utilizes tremendous leaping prowess, and occasionally inhales objects or summons minions.

mechanisms: Heavy armor plating in certain appearances

weaknesses: Slow recovery times after heavy hammer swings

sources.supports: Hammer combat, physical stats, and abilities.

feats.claim: Smashed through thick stone pillars and cracked terrain with his hammer.

notableResults.note: Defeated at the top of Mt. Dedede.

campaignTags.claim: Significantly larger and heavier than standard humanoid fighters.
Can float temporarily by inflating his body.

unknowns: Exact strength multiplier when possessed by dark forces.

characters.summary: Kirby is a pink spherical hero with the ability to inhale enemies and copy their abilities, combining immense versatility with high-speed flight and resilience.
limitations: Must drop copied abilities when taking heavy damage or voluntarily exhaling

sources.supports: Inhalation, copy ability mechanics, and general feats.

feats.claim: Inhaled and swallowed giant boss enemies whole to copy their powers.

notableResults.note: Defeated Dedede to recover stolen food.

campaignTags.claim: Can inflate himself to fly freely through the air.
Swims easily in deep water without drowning.

unknowns: Upper limit of the physical mass Kirby can inhale.

characters.summary: Hypernova Kirby is a powered-up state gained by eating a Miracle Fruit, allowing him to inhale massive obstacles, trees, and entire boss structures with overwhelming suction power.

mechanisms: Overwhelming suction vortex deflecting incoming projectiles

weaknesses: Dependent on the duration of the Miracle Fruit power-up
mobility: Standard floating combined with massive suction pull
limitations: Temporary form tied to specific level triggers
characters.formDifferences: Massively amplifies inhale range and suction strength to pull in gigantic objects and structures.

feats.claim: Inhaled and destroyed giant armored boss armor and massive tree trunks with ease.

notableResults.note: Used Hypernova suction to tear apart Sectonia's giant floral defenses.

unknowns: Whether Hypernova suction can affect abstract or non-physical entities.

characters.summary: Star Rod Kirby wields the legendary Star Rod, enabling him to fire concentrated star-energy projectiles and pierce magical corruption.

mechanisms: Magical energy deflection via Star Rod

weaknesses: Vulnerable if disarmed of the Star Rod
mobility: Standard flight and Warp Star movement
limitations: Power source is tied to the magical integrity of the Star Rod
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard copy abilities with direct projection of star energy beams from the Star Rod.

sources.supports: Star Rod powers and energy projection.

feats.claim: Destroyed the Fountain of Dreams' source of corruption using the Star Rod.

notableResults.note: Shot down Nightmare using Star Rod star beams.

conditional.ability: Star projectile shooting and magic dispersion

campaignTags.claim: Wields the magical Star Rod weapon.

unknowns: Limits of the Star Rod against cosmic entities outside Popstar.
